title: Ask Fred welcome/intro screen with session-persisted dismissal

requirements.summary: Show a welcome/intro view on the Ask Fred page before the chat UI, with clear examples and a prominent start action while keeping the existing disclaimer unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user opens the Ask Fred page, they see an intro/welcome view before the chat history (at least on first visit).

The welcome view includes English user-facing text that communicates: (1) Fred is a Clash Royale strategy helper, (2) example topics users can ask about (e.g., elixir, win conditions, deck archetypes, spell choices), and (3) a prominent action (e.g., "Start chatting") that takes the user into the chat UI.
After the user dismisses/starts the chat from the welcome view, the normal chat UI is shown and the input is focused.
The existing disclaimer remains visible and unchanged in meaning (still states Fred is offline/limited knowledge, informational only, not affiliated with Supercell, and no unblocked/bypass help).

file_operations.description: Create a reusable welcome/intro panel component for Ask Fred with explanatory text, example question/topic list, and a prominent "Start chatting" CTA. Use existing shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Button) for consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add conditional rendering so first-time (per session) visitors see the new welcome/intro panel before the chat history. Ensure the existing disclaimer (FRED_DISCLAIMER) remains visible and unchanged in meaning. When the user clicks the CTA, transition to the chat UI and programmatically focus the message input (Textarea). Use existing shadcn-ui components already present on this page; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Persist dismissal of the Ask Fred intro during the browser session and provide a non-intrusive way to re-open the intro.
acceptanceCriteria: After the user starts/dismisses the welcome screen once, revisiting the Ask Fred page within the same browser session does not show the welcome screen again (chat UI appears directly).
Provide a simple way to re-open the intro (e.g., a small "About Fred" / "Show intro" action) without interfering with chat usage.

file_operations.description: Create a small hook to read/write a boolean flag in sessionStorage (e.g., intro dismissed) to persist state across navigation within the same browser session.

Integrate session-based persistence for the intro dismissal (via the new hook) so the intro is shown only until dismissed in the current session. Add a small "About Fred" / "Show intro" action in the Ask Fred UI (e.g., in the chat header area) that reopens the intro without disrupting normal chat usage; use existing shadcn-ui Button styling patterns; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
